title: Outlaw
description: Outlaw is an absolute knockout with his stunning golden color and Snow White mane & tail that goes on forever! He definitely turns heads everywhere you take him. His inquisitive, loving and sweet personality will seal the deal and his calm and quiet demeanor will make you fall in love over and over. Outlaw has been trained in the reining and does all maneuvers easily. He has a comfortable jog and lope on a draped rein and is more of a push-style horse. If you think whoa, Outlaw slides to a stop. He has stylish spins, easy lead changes and you can close your eyes in a run down and he stops pretty every time. Outlaw has a naturally level headset and is an elegant mover. He has Ranch Riding and Ranch Versatility written all over him. He guides willingly and directly. Outlaw has been all over our ranch and would make the fanciest ride for the ranch Foreman. He walks out nicely, easily side passes to the gates, and knows what a days work is all about. If you need to go rope a steer in the pasture and doctor one, he will work the rope and do his part. Outlaw is always gentle and completely beginner friendly. He is a super fun horse to have around the barn and always game for whatever the day may bring. Whether his job is babysitting the kiddos or packing around your mother-in-law or spending a day in the sorting pens or out on the ranch, Outlaw will be your go-to. Nothing bothers this gorgeous gelding. Bring on the rough terrain and mud, blowing tarps, crazy dogs, noisy traffic, loud gunfire, pushy pigs and even a giant camel. Outlaw is a barn favorite. He is the entire package. Black-type pedigree, stunning looks, balanced conformation, puppy-dog disposition, and the talent and willingness to do anything you want to horseback.
